policyDraft: Draft policy · Legal review required before launch
termsBody: Adults only. Submit authorized photos of one adult. Portraits are AI-assisted; exact resemblance is not guaranteed. No celebrity impersonation, protected character designs, or illegal content. Your original names and titles remain unchanged. Test prices are provisional. The seller identity, address, tax details, governing law and final delivery terms must be completed before paid sales.
privacyBody: Photos are stored privately and are accessible only through authorized sessions. We record order details and consent timestamps. Image metadata is removed during processing. We do not use customer photos for marketing or training without separate permission. Deletion removes active storage copies; infrastructure backups may follow separate retention. No external AI or email service is connected in this demo. Retention cleanup runs hourly when its schedule is active; expired files are blocked immediately. Optional first-party measurement uses a one-day session cookie and retains pseudonymous visit/step data for 30 days. You can decline or withdraw in Measurement preferences. Operational order records remain separate.
refundBody: One revision request is included initially for poor resemblance, visible defects, or a wrong style. Generation failures are routed to manual fulfillment or refund review. Refund eligibility depends on the circumstances and applicable consumer law. No blanket exclusion applies to all digital products. Demo refunds move no money. Final jurisdiction-specific terms need legal review.
